_note: Labeled interview answers for calibrating the STAR rubric (engine/content.py). Best-effort labels — answered_question and which STAR elements a sympathetic rater would mark present. The calibration test asserts answered_question exactly and STAR count within one.

cases.question: Tell me about a time you had a conflict with a coworker and how you resolved it.
cases.answer: On my last team, a senior engineer and I disagreed about whether to rewrite our payments service. I was responsible for delivering the release on time, so I needed to resolve it without derailing the schedule. I set up a one-on-one, listened to his concerns, and proposed we split the rewrite into a phased migration with clear metrics. We agreed, shipped phase one two weeks early, and cut payment errors by thirty percent.

cases.question: Describe a time you failed. What happened and what did you learn?
cases.answer: I think I'm a really hard worker and I always give a hundred percent. I don't really like to dwell on failures, I prefer to stay positive.

cases.question: Describe a situation where you had to meet a tight deadline under pressure.
cases.answer: We had a launch coming up and the timeline was really tight. So I stayed late a few nights and coordinated with the design team to get the assets in. We were all pretty stressed about it.

cases.question: What is your greatest strength, and can you give a concrete example of it in action?
cases.answer: My greatest strength is staying calm under pressure. For example, during a production outage last year, I kept the team focused, delegated the investigation cleanly, and we restored service in under an hour.
